articles.title: anthropics/skills
articles.excerpt: Public repository for Agent Skills
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方公开的 Agent Skills 仓库，提供可直接复用的技能定义与示例，让 Claude 等 AI agent 通过模块化技能包扩展能力。开发者可参考其结构编写自定义 skill，用于工具调用、任务自动化等场景，是构建 agent 工作流的入门与规范参考。

articles.title: meta/astryx
articles.excerpt: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
articles.summary: Meta 开源的设计系统，强调高度可定制与面向 AI agent 的适配能力，提供组件、样式 token 与主题机制。前端团队可基于它搭建统一的产品界面，同时让 agent 读取设计规范生成一致 UI，适合需要规模化设计与自动化生成组件的团队。

articles.title: sherlock-project/sherlock
articles.excerpt: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
articles.summary: 经典开源情报工具，通过用户名在数百个社交网站批量探测账号是否存在，输出各平台命中链接。基于 Python 实现，支持命令行批量查询与结果导出，常用于安全研究、渗透测试前的资产梳理与 OSINT 调查。

articles.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
articles.excerpt: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
articles.summary: DeepMind 开源的通用物理仿真引擎，专注多关节刚体动力学与接触求解，计算高效、精度高。广泛用于机器人控制、强化学习环境搭建与生物力学研究，提供 C 接口及 Python 绑定，是 MuJoCo 系列基准任务的底层引擎。

articles.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
articles.excerpt: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方示例集合，围绕 Claude API 提供多个可运行项目模板，覆盖对话、工具调用、检索增强等常见形态。开发者可据此快速搭出可部署的原型，减少从零配置的时间，适合初次接入 Claude 做产品验证的团队。

articles.title: garrytan/gbrain
articles.excerpt: Garry's Opinionated OpenClaw/Hermes Agent Brain
articles.summary: Garry Tan 开源的 agent 大脑配置方案，面向 OpenClaw/Hermes 一类 agent 框架，带有强烈个人偏好设定的提示词与工作流组织方式。适合想直接套用成熟 agent 行为规范、快速搭建个人助理或自动化代理的开发者参考改造。

articles.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
articles.excerpt: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
articles.summary: Vercel Labs 出品的浏览器自动化命令行工具，专为 AI agent 设计，可让模型通过简单命令完成页面导航、元素点击与内容抓取。适合构建网页操作类 agent、自动化测试与数据采集流程，降低接入浏览器控制的门槛。

articles.title: ruvnet/RuView
articles.excerpt: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
articles.summary: 利用普通 WiFi 信号的 CSI 变化做实时空间感知，实现人体存在检测、呼吸心率等生命体征监测，全程不采集任何视频画面。相比摄像头方案更保护隐私、可穿墙，适合居家养老看护、智能家居联动与无摄像头安防场景。

articles.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
articles.excerpt: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
articles.summary: LLM 驱动的多市场股票分析系统，聚合多源行情与实时新闻，由大模型生成分析结论，配决策看板并支持定时自动推送。可零成本部署定时运行，适合个人投资者做每日复盘与盯盘，减少手工收集数据的时间。

articles.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
articles.excerpt: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
articles.summary: 为 Home Assistant 提供 MCP 服务端，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手直接读取设备状态、编写自动化与修改配置。智能家居用户可用自然语言完成场景编排和排障，免去手写 YAML，适合已部署 Home Assistant 想接入大模型的人群。

articles.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot

articles.excerpt: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates. Here’s how we quickly patched Cloudflare, what evidence we can see of attempted exploitation, and how much of the rest of the Internet remains exposed.

articles.title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available

articles.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants

articles.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
articles.excerpt: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.

articles.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
articles.excerpt: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.

articles.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang
articles.excerpt: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Here is how we addressed the issue.

articles.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
articles.excerpt: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

articles.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

articles.title: Localizing compliance at scale: Achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

articles.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

articles.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.
